plan_summary: Verify nginx installation by checking OS type, binary presence, and package registry status.

tasks.title: Identify Linux Distribution and Package Manager
tasks.objective: Determine OS type to select appropriate verification commands.
tasks.rationale: Package manager commands vary by distribution (e.g., apt vs yum).
tasks.expected_output: Detected distro name and package manager identifier

tasks.title: Verify nginx Binary Presence
tasks.objective: Confirm the executable exists on the host filesystem.
tasks.rationale: Direct binary check confirms physical installation regardless of package state.
tasks.expected_output: Path to nginx binary or confirmation of absence

tasks.title: Check Installed Packages for nginx
tasks.objective: Validate installation status through system package registry.
tasks.rationale: Package manager query provides official installation record.
